A servo, a chip, and nothing else

Two WebAssembly modules in one tab. The emulator runs real ESP32-C3 firmware that drives an SG90 servo with the stock ledc driver on GPIO 4. sg90.wasm, built from examples/parts/sg90, is told the period and the pulse width on its pin whenever they change, and turns its horn to the angle the pulse commands; a hardware fade sweeps it with no register write.

Pick the two files this page runs. The firmware is test_apps/pwm_servo built for esp32c3 (its merged flash image). The part is sg90.wasm, built from examples/parts/sg90.
